item.title: Oswego County legislators assess safety after two truck accidents at Palermo intersection
item.description: Two tractor-trailers have been involved in accidents at the same Palermo intersection in one week, raising safety concerns among residents and prompting Oswego County officials to review the situation and implement potential improvements.

item.title: US issues a license that authorizes sales of Venezuelan gold
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — The U.S. issued a license Friday that authorizes dealings with Minerven, Venezuela's state-owned gold mining company, in the latest sign of the Trump administration’s intent to exercise more control over that country’s natural resources. item.title: Syracuse icon returns home after being stuck in Dubai
item.description: Ralph Rotella, owner of Ralph's Shoe Repair in Syracuse, returned home after being stranded in Dubai due to flight cancellations caused by escalating conflict in Iran.
